# React Bits workspace adapters

Source: https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits
Pinned revision: e12c22192ac7b4b452c5e2feb9b586d74765d696
Variant: ts-default. License: MIT + Commons Clause (LICENSE.md).

ClickSpark clamps negative elapsed frame time to zero (an event can spawn after the RAF timestamp in the same frame). SpotlightCard and Magnet accept existing target nodes so native forms, listeners and record IDs remain owned by the app. Spotlight styles are owned by workspace.css, not the demo stylesheet. BlurText renders inline spans and allows Chinese wrapping inside the shared completion status. The app gates animated decoration on its shared reduced-motion policy; GradientText retains a static gradient when reduced motion is enabled. No source component is sold separately.

AnimatedContent also accepts an existing target, using mount-only fades with no calendar displacement. GSAP is pinned in package-lock.json.

GradientText uses the JavaScript + CSS source supplied for the 2026-10-26 integration (no upstream revision was supplied for this component). It adds an existing-heading target adapter, live reduced-motion handling, hidden-document/offscreen suspension and forced-colors fallback. Its CSS is component-owned and uses the wb- prefix for the existing asset scoper. Homepage callers use the user-requested React Bits example palette through heading-gradient-* component tokens, an eight-second flow and glow 0.4 without a pill; the work overview navigation retains its button and the personal heading retains its original text node, with an aria-hidden glow portal.

BellToggle uses the JavaScript + CSS source supplied for the 2026-10-26 integration (no upstream revision supplied). The app uses its action variant to open the existing reminders dialog, without subscription state or aria-pressed. wb-icon-button owns the 44px/16px shell and wb-notification-count owns the unchanged 99+ badge. While ready with a nonzero reminder count, the Hugeicons bell and waves run a short ring about every five seconds. The interval does not restart when the count changes but remains positive. Clearing the count, disabling the button, reduced motion, hiding the document or unmounting immediately cancels the timer and active animations; returning to a visible document resumes the cue. Clicks and keyboard activation only open reminders; shared reduced-motion policy cancels ringing, including in-flight WAAPI animations. Unmount cancels bell, clapper, wave and spring animations. Original pill toggle remains available with its explicit props. Hugeicons dependencies are pinned and licenses are included in Tasks assets.

RubberSegment uses the JavaScript + CSS source supplied for the 2026-10-26 integration (no upstream revision supplied). WorkspaceSegment supplies existing theme tokens and 44px targets. The adaptation adds keyboard/assistive click activation, navigation veto, live reduced-motion cancellation, guarded font measurements, lifecycle animation cleanup and transition continuity when native views rebuild. Native adapters retain source nodes/listeners and restore selection focus after rebuilding. Only explicit choice groups are adapted; independent actions and calendar mobile dropdowns retain their existing behavior. No new dependency is required.

SpringCheck uses the JavaScript + CSS source supplied for the 2026-10-26 integration (no upstream revision supplied). WorkspaceCompletion applies existing checkbox/text tokens, 22px visuals and 44px hit targets. It is used only for completion: tasks (board/table/home), check-ins, requirements, project issues, habit/event lists and completed training sets. Selection and preference checkboxes retain their original owners. Native business fields remain hidden and nonfocusable solely for checked/disabled state, original change listeners and rollback; their former visible text/styling is retired. The adapter forwards focus to the sole visible checkbox, observes disabled changes and intercepts checked-property rollback; disconnected roots release observers, property bridges and springs. Task identity preserves spring continuity across board moves. Keyboard activation animates, reduced motion cancels springs, and focus returns after pending operations. Component CSS is wb-prefixed for the existing asset scoper and includes forced-colors treatment. Existing pinned Motion/Hugeicons dependencies and packaged licenses are reused.
